notes.title: I found the bug!
notes.content: I finally found that pesky bug and squashed it! Magilore is now playable until the end of the game. At this point, I will update it this evening with the newest version. I am very sorry that it has taken literally a month.

notes.title: World Map

You have to go to the inner bottom left corner of the world map. While an in-game NPC explains it, I'll do so as well. For all of them (except the earth and air kingdoms), you need to go to the inner-bottom-left hand corner. For those two, you have to go to the bottom left hand corner. The picture here also shows what tiles ot go to.

notes.title: The game is out!
notes.content: Magilore is now avaliable for free until the end of 2017. I'm pretty sure that I caught all of the bugs and spelling mistakes. But unless there are any major gamebreaking glitches, my work on this game is done. I've worked on it for 2 years now and I need to move on, ya know? Also, the mac version is not working, sadly. I'll try to work on that, but no guarantees. Thank you and enjoy the game.
